reasoning: The icon is a pure alphanumeric badge ('10K' inside a rounded box) representing a media resolution setting or quantity rather than a concrete object. While it can match niche tasks around a 10K race or SEC Form 10-K, a runner or document icon communicates those subjects much better at a glance, and at small sizes the text blurs into other resolution badges like 4K or 8K.
